semantic_insights: The DOI, dataset identifier and FAIRhub landing-page identifier agree.
The race/ethnicity totals, sex totals, diabetes-status totals and recommended split counts each sum to 2280 participants.
Human-subject participation is supported by named IRB approval and multisite reliance agreements.
Consent procedures, required participation consent and withdrawal limitations are consistent across the consent fields.
Aggregate demographic summaries are distinguished from participant-level demographic attributes withheld from the public release; controlled-access data are explicitly outside the evaluated release.
The NIH funding mechanisms and award identifiers are plausible and align with the stated salutogenesis and AI-ready data purposes.
Initial ethics approval precedes collection; the stated collection interval ends before publication, and release dates progress consistently through versions 1, 2 and 3.

Disease-specific consent, access requirements and intended uses consistently restrict use to type 2 diabetes research; general commercial and non-commercial license permissions are presented within those conditions.
